explanation: All SNPs annotated as broad retinal OCR in the formal analysis feature matrix.
Only 1,069 of 1,232 DAR SNPs overlap broad retinal OCR; 163 DAR SNPs are outside OCR and are not subtracted from the OCR denominator.
The matched non-DAR annotation is built after removing OCR intervals overlapping DAR intervals, excluding 267 additional non-DAR OCR SNPs.
